findings.affected_requirement: FR-007, SC-001, plan AD-5, and the durable-store all-captured-StateVersion contract
findings.evidence: The coordinator iterates the captured jobs and calls ApplyRecoveryTransitionAsync once per job, returning immediately if a later transition conflicts, then calls the same method separately for PausedToPrepared. The repository executes SaveChangesAsync inside each call. There is no transaction spanning the recovery set, so an earlier expired-lease or due-retry transition can be durably committed before a later stale-version, integrity, cancellation, or phase conflict returns failure. This contradicts accepted plan.md line 123, which requires one transaction after revalidation, and durable-scan-contracts.md line 13, which requires a conditional transition against every captured StateVersion. Existing recovery tests cover happy-path mixed states and repeated idempotence but do not inject a later transition failure and prove zero partial mutation.
findings.correction_outcome: Add a public-seam behavioral RED with at least two eligible jobs where the first transition would succeed and a later captured version/integrity/cancellation check fails; assert that neither job nor the Scan Execution phase changes. Implement one batch recovery store command/transaction that validates every captured execution/job StateVersion and integrity condition before committing all eligible job and phase transitions exactly once. Then rerun convergence and quality review.

summary: REVISE. The corrected immutable Story 12.1 boundary closes prior QR-001, QR-002, and QR-003: the three correction groups pass 43/43 and static inspection confirms complete canonical manifest equality, Infrastructure-derived commit fingerprints before mutation/replay, and bounded configured-health failure with cancellation propagation. Adjacent recovery/API/model tests pass 37/37 and Vulgata.Web builds with zero errors. The broad DurableScanning/AnalysisRuntime filter produced 157 passed and one environment failure because PostgreSQL at 127.0.0.1:5432 was unavailable; that infrastructure failure is not treated as a product finding. One new HIGH implementation defect remains: manual resume persists per-job and phase recovery transitions separately instead of as the accepted single conditional transaction, permitting partial durable mutation before a later conflict. Because Story 12.1 changes API, persistence, migration/data lifecycle, and multi-module runtime behavior, E2E remains required after correction and fresh convergence/quality acceptance.
